description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_Switch, which serves as a decorator to switch between two attribute definitions based on a token (specifically, a tag name) within the HTMLPurifier library. It includes methods for initialization and validation, determining which attribute definition to invoke based on the current token context.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_Switch
classes.description: A decorator class that switches between two attribute definitions depending on the current token (tag) in the context.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the switch with a specific tag name and two attribute definitions, one for matching the tag and one for not matching.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the input string depending on the current token in the context; delegates to the appropriate attribute definition based on the token.
